name: Test Simple Geographic
description: Configuration basique pour tester les fonctions géographiques

continent.definition: DEFINE TABLE continent TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL;
fields: DEFINE FIELD code ON continent TYPE string;
DEFINE FIELD name ON continent TYPE string;
DEFINE FIELD isActive ON continent TYPE bool DEFAULT true;

region.definition: DEFINE TABLE region TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL;
fields: DEFINE FIELD name ON region TYPE string;
DEFINE FIELD continentId ON region TYPE record<continent>;
DEFINE FIELD isActive ON region TYPE bool DEFAULT true;

subRegion.definition: DEFINE TABLE subRegion TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL;
fields: DEFINE FIELD name ON subRegion TYPE string;
DEFINE FIELD regionId ON subRegion TYPE record<region>;
DEFINE FIELD isActive ON subRegion TYPE bool DEFAULT true;

data: CREATE continent:eu SET code = 'EU', name = 'Europe', isActive = true;
CREATE continent:as SET code = 'AS', name = 'Asie', isActive = true;
CREATE region:western_eu SET name = 'Europe de l\'Ouest', continentId = continent:eu, isActive = true;
CREATE region:eastern_eu SET name = 'Europe de l\'Est', continentId = continent:eu, isActive = true;
CREATE region:south_asia SET name = 'Asie du Sud', continentId = continent:as, isActive = true;
CREATE subRegion:france SET name = 'France', regionId = region:western_eu, isActive = true;
CREATE subRegion:germany SET name = 'Allemagne', regionId = region:western_eu, isActive = true;
CREATE subRegion:poland SET name = 'Pologne', regionId = region:eastern_eu, isActive = true;
CREATE subRegion:india SET name = 'Inde', regionId = region:south_asia, isActive = true;
